response.justification: Bogdan is fundamentally mismatched for this role despite strong general software engineering credentials. The position requires a hands-on C++ systems programmer with industrial automation and embedded systems expertise. His C++ experience is minimal (6 months in 2014-2015, now 11+ years outdated) and his 20-year career has focused entirely on modern full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, React). Critically absent are industrial automation experience, IoT background, security standards knowledge (SDL, IEC 62443), multi-threaded systems expertise, and familiarity with industrial protocols. His current trajectory moves further from systems programming into AI-agent infrastructure.
strengths: Extensive 20-year software development background with proven ability to master diverse technology stacks and deliver scalable solutions
Strong engineering practices demonstrated through TDD, CI/CD, clean code, and mentoring—valuable transferable skills
Possesses some advantageous skills including React, Node.js, and AWS CDK experience for cloud-based solutions
concerns: Critical gap: C++ experience is minimal (6 months) and severely outdated (11 years); role requires hands-on C++ architecture and development expertise
No demonstrated background in industrial automation, IoT, embedded systems, or industrial cybersecurity standards (SDL, IEC 62443)—core focus areas
Career specialization in web/full-stack development with recent focus on AI infrastructure; moving away from systems programming required for this role

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and embedded systems background
